answer: Pair random keys for a live cross-examination each epoch: at dawn on the ledger clock, each key must question its partner's last answer and defend its own against the reply. A farm cannot whisper one script to every key, because the questions arrive unseen and in real time. Keys whose rebuttals bend the same way, like willow branches in one wind, are clustered and share a single reward, so extra identities add cost but no pay.
